title: The Court takes all three objectives
html:
Battle Round 1

The Court takes all three objectives

VP
2:9
Units standing
8:7
HP on the field
77:88

Commentary

  1. Command

    The Court spends its 3 CP on the Troop Requisition, the Host 1 of its 3 on Double Time for the Sagdid Hound-Keepers (+2 MOVE, a move it could not have made without it). Both sides keep BAR THE GATES.

  2. Movement

    The Court advances every unit at an objective. The Masque of Carnality (8,7) and the Veiled Queen with Cultist Troopers 1 (6,6) take the centre; the Queen Consort (2,6) and the new Cultist Troopers (2,7) the west; Cultist Troopers 2 the east (12,7). The Host comes up more slowly: the Javidan with the Mobad to (6,10), Shieldbearers 2 to (11,9), Shieldbearers 1 to (5,11), and the Spahbed's Aswaran ride the west edge to (0,7), beside the west objective.

  3. Action

    One shot all round: the Aswaran's carbines take 4 HP and two Cultists off the requisitioned squad at the west objective. Everyone else, on both sides, has nothing legal in reach.

  4. Cleanup

    The Court holds all three objectives for 7 VP. Both sides complete BAR THE GATES (+2). Veiled Court 9, Spahbed's Host 2.
